name: This file is a superset of CSV; intended to be parseable
with standard CSV tools but also human-readable and -editable.
Comment lines start with '#' and a comma; that is they have '#' in the first
field. Blank lines should be ignored too.
Avoid commas in comments; you can use semicolons.
Each non-comment line has these mandatory columns:
- dtype: basic data type (which field of the union to use)
- 'any' works for any of the above
After these there can be 0 or more "named" columns whose contents start with
with '<name>='; everything after that is the value. No spaces around '='.
Perhaps CSV shouldn't be used this way; sue me.
- 'added': Python version that added the slot
- 'PyObject=true': This is a Python object (or NULL)
